results.expected_honest: a physical-value change MUST change content_version and MUST stale dependent evidence (validation -> stale, last_result keeps 'passing' visible)
results.observed: content_version unchanged after value 4.6e-10 -> 9.9e-10; stale_evidence() == []; refresh_validation() flipped []; validation remains 'passing'

results.title: capture records object content_versions only; removing carries_signal_to cannot stale
results.expected_honest: removing a relation that the evidence's measurement covered MUST stale that evidence
results.observed: relation removed from authored inputs and full rebuild run; captured unchanged (objects only); refresh_validation flipped []; validation remains 'passing'; no warning raised

results.title: `captured or {}` -- empty capture passes; even dep deletion is invisible
results.expected_honest: an empty capture MUST NOT pass: staleness is unknowable, so the record must flip to stale (reason 'capture missing/empty') or the API must refuse, never report clean
results.observed: captured={} record stayed 'passing' through a physics-relevant mutation (spatial.v0_m3 0.287914 -> 0.5) AND through deletion of the dep object; zero mismatches reported in both cases

results.title: unconditional re-stamp rewrites historical capture; validation/captured_utc untouched
results.expected_honest: a rebuild MUST NOT rewrite the historical capture; if it re-stamps it MUST update captured_utc and/or stale the evidence -- (captured, captured_utc) must never describe two different moments
results.observed: rebuild rewrote captured to the new versions while captured_utc kept 2026-09-15T13:47:00Z; refresh_validation flipped []; validation remains 'passing'; the v0 change is now undetectable via the store API

results.title: load records loaded_schema_version without comparing; unsupported schema versions load

results.title: runtime-to-graph matching chooses ambiguous cells greedily (matches[0]; used-exclusion in cross_check is still greedy/unflagged)
results.expected_honest: ambiguous band matches MUST be flagged and MUST NOT silently decide pass/fail when a consistent assignment exists (join both instances to distinct cells, or report 'ambiguous: N candidates')
results.observed: map_cells_to_instances double-books live cell 0 (both rows engine_cell_index=0, cell 1 unused, match='by band geometry'); cross_check fails BOTH v0 checks under greedy used-exclusion although the perfect assignment (_a->cell1, _b->cell0) exists; no ambiguity flag anywhere

results.title: exact conservation zero fails via `or 1.0`
results.expected_honest: |conserve_pct| < 0.01 must pass INCLUDING exactly 0.0 (the best case); None must be reported as missing, not swapped for a sentinel
results.observed: conserve_pct=0.0 -> check ok=False (sentinel 1.0 substituted); conserve_pct=1e-6 -> check ok=True; all other checks green in both reports, so the falsy-zero alone fails a perfect world

results.title: duplicate boundary edges manufacture closure (no wall-id dedup; n_support sums relation rows)
results.expected_honest: closure must count DISTINCT walls: one wall registered twice is one wall, verdict stays 'boundary pending build' (an enclosure needs >1 wall)
results.observed: one registration -> 'boundary pending build'; the SAME wall registered twice -> 'physically bounded'; bounding_membranes lists memb.septum.solo twice
